title: Quasi-coherence over a quasi-coherent algebra agrees with quasi-coherence over the structure sheaf
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. An *$\mathcal A$-module* is a sheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules on $S$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; it is an $\mathcal O_S$-module through the structure map $\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal A$. An $\mathcal A$-module $\mathcal G$ is *quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module* if every point of $S$ has an open neighbourhood $W$ with an exact sequence $\bigoplus_{j\in J}\mathcal A|_W\to\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal A|_W\to\mathcal G|_W\to0$ of $\mathcal A|_W$-modules, for some sets $I,J$ (direct sums taken in the category of $\mathcal A|_W$-modules). Then an $\mathcal A$-module $\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module if and only if its underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Restriction of scalars preserves small colimits: both forgetful functors to abelian sheaves preserve colimits by moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful, the composite with scalar restriction is the other forgetful functor, and the target forgetful functor reflects colimits because it reflects isomorphisms.

For a colimit-preserving additive functor into scheme modules, a global presentation has quasi-coherent image if the image of the ring module is quasi-coherent. Use PreservesCoproduct.iso and isQuasicoherent_sigma for the free terms, Presentation.isColimit and PreservesCokernel.iso to identify the image with their cokernel, and isQuasicoherent_cokernel for closure. These are the existing source-library coproduct and cokernel closure theorems; the stronger cokernel-image theorem is unnecessary.

For the forward implication choose a quasi-coherent presentation cover of G. On each member U, scalar restriction followed by overEquiv U preserves colimits and sends the algebra unit to A.toModule restricted to U, which is quasi-coherent. Apply the preceding presentation argument, transport back along overEquiv U using isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint and its unit isomorphism, then glue with SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop. No affine refinement or tilde comparison is needed for this implication.

For the converse, the affine opens of S cover the top by S.isBasis_affineOpens. On each affine U, underlying quasi-coherence restricts to U by SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_over. Apply nonempty_algebraModule_presentation_over, then Presentation.isQuasicoherent. Glue these local assertions with IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop. The split theorem contains only the affine presentation portion of the converse, not the forward implication or the global gluing.

split_report.summary: Mathlib leaf decision (B8): not a leaf (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, grep repeated; Mathlib has SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent and SheafOfModules.restrictScalars but nothing relating them). Statement kept (it agrees with Stacks 0H88, with quasi-coherence over A spelled out as local presentations by direct sums of copies of A in Mod(A|_W)); stmt_deps kept. Proof follows Morphisms 0H88 (morphisms.tex line 1845), both directions, with the source's '(details omitted)' and tacit steps written out: Step 1 (via lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful, Modules on Sites 03DA/03DB) direct sums in Mod(A|_W) are direct sums in Mod(O_W) and exactness is the same in both; Step 2 on an affine U=Spec R the direct sum of copies of A|_U is (sum A)~ with explicit global sections (restriction node 01AJ/01BG, tilde-gamma adjunction 01I7/01ID), hence quasi-coherent; Step 3 the direction A-qcoh => O-qcoh via the cokernel lemma 01IC/01LA; Steps 4-6 the converse: A=A(U), M=G(U) with its A-module structure, a free presentation of M, the A|_U-linear maps defined from it, and exactness checked by comparing with the tilde of the presentation through the adjunction bijection. The citer lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence uses both directions (its Step 2: O-qcoh => A-qcoh; Steps 3 and 7: A-qcoh => O-qcoh); both are proved. No new node. Tool use outside unit sk-thm-p1: lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful (unit sk-thm-reduction, split, not a Mathlib leaf).
